messages.subject: MSstatsTMT
parts:
I am hoping to run "designSampleSize" in MSstats from MSstatsTMT results. I found these functions "MSstatsPrepareForGroupComparisonTMT" and " MSstatsFitComparisonModelsTMT" that seem to produce the output needed for designSampleSize() but I cannot find where to find the code for these, as they are not included in the MSstatsTMT package.

Does anyone have any information on these functions or how to run designSampleSize from MSstatsTMT groupComparisonTMT results?

https://rdrr.io/github/Vitek-Lab/MSstatsTMT/man/MSstatsFitComparisonModelsTMT.html

Thank you!

messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsTMT
parts:
Currently, designSampleSize function does not support MSstatsTMT. So it is unable to run designSampleSize from MSstatsTMT groupComparisonTMT results. This is one of the future work we are working on.

-Ting
